name: bucket-activity-console-error
goal: Normal bucket-backed console browsing loads recorded activity without a browser 404

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: A normal bucket-backed console must load recorded activity without a browser 404. consoleObjects excluded activity.json even though the installed console reads it.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: test/console-object-activity.test.ts failed: history/activity.json was absent. The unchanged console-storage browser flow failed with a 404 for /harness/data/activity.json; before screenshot is from the same manual local fixture.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Included activity.json in the bucket upload whitelist while preserving the exclusion of unrelated files. Kept the browser error assertion enabled.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged unit regression and all 5 console-storage tests passed. The same isolated browser regression then failed solely for activity.json HTTP 404 with the original manifest and passed after repair, saving inspected 1440 x 900 before/after screenshots before its error assertion. Manual validation of the same live local fixture also returned HTTP 200 and rendered its repository label.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Focused browser error, bucket activity, and lazy fixture proofs pass. Full verification remains pending: reports-concurrent-runs.e2e.test.ts times out at its unchanged 180-second history-seeding assertion on both this implementation and isolated baseline ff47c377, before browser results.
